# SpecFlow — GitHub Copilot

This project uses **SpecFlow** (`@ceatoleii/specflow`).

## Required on every task

1. Read `.agents/rules/orchestrator.md` before acting.
2. If `.agents-state/.flow-enabled` exists, follow the phase agent in `.agents/rules/`.
3. Only the Implementer agent may write or edit code files.

## Activation phrases

- Start: `nueva tarea`, `activar flujo`, `flow on`
- Stop: `modo directo`, `flow off`

See `AGENTS.md` for the full workflow.
